the interconnect can perform this check.  This trace source is the trace of those reset state
changes.)

    Field value type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (The value driven.)

Source EXCEPTION (Exception taken.)
    Field PC type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The location where the exception occurred.)
    Field LR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The value assigned to the link register.)
    Field PREFERRED_RETURN type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The preferred return address for the exception.)
    Field TARGET_PC type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The address the exception branches to.)
    Field VECTOR type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (The exception vector.)
        0x0 = Reset
        0x4 = UndefinedInstr
        0x8 = SWI
        0xc = PrefetchAbort
        0x10 = handleDataAbort
        0x14 = Hyp
        0x18 = IRQ
        0x1c = FIQ
        0x80 = CURRENT_SP0_SYNC
        0x81 = CURRENT_SP0_IRQ
        0x82 = CURRENT_SP0_FIQ
        0x83 = CURRENT_SP0_ABORT
        0x84 = CURRENT_SPx_SYNC
        0x85 = CURRENT_SPx_IRQ
        0x86 = CURRENT_SPx_FIQ
        0x87 = CURRENT_SPx_ABORT
        0x88 = LOWER_64_SYNC
        0x89 = LOWER_64_IRQ
        0x8a = LOWER_64_FIQ
        0x8b = LOWER_64_ABORT
        0x8c = LOWER_32_SYNC
        0x8d = LOWER_32_IRQ
        0x8e = LOWER_32_FIQ
        0x8f = LOWER_32_ABORT
        0x90 = DEBUG_SYNC
        0x91 = DEBUG_IRQ
        0x92 = DEBUG_FIQ
        0x93 = DEBUG_ABORT
        0xf8 = Thumb2EE Check Array
        0xfc = Thumb2EE Null Check
    Field TARGET_ISET type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (The instruction set of the exception handler code.)
        0x0 = ARM
        0x1 = Thumb
        0x2 = Jazelle
        0x4 = AArch64
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field IS_PHYSICAL type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Physical or Virtual exception)
    Field VECTOR_OFFSET type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:2 (The offset of an exception vector from the base address.)
    Field IS_TRAP type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Exception coming from a trap)
    Field ESR_EC type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The Value assigned to  ESR.EC when exception is taken)
    Field TAKEN_LOCALLY type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Whether exception is taken locally(same exception level))

Source UNALIGNED_LDST_RETIRED (Processor unaligned load/store.)
    Field VADDR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The virtual address of the access)
    Field NUMBER_OF_BEATS type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:2 (Number of accesses (beats) in this burst (Total size in bytes is ACCESS_SIZE * NUMBER_OF_BEATS))
    Field ACCESS_SIZE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Log2 of the access width in bytes used for alignment checking (1=>half-word, 2->word ...))

Source VFP_D_REGS (VFP/NEON D 64 bit register write.)
    Field ID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The register number.)
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The new value written to the register.)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The old value overwritten.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field ALIASING type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Type of register aliasing used)
        0x1 = AArch32
        0x2 = AArch64
    Field MASK type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Each bit indicates a write to the corresponding bit in the register. For example, 0x1 would indicate a write to VALUE[0])

Source VFP_Q_REGS (VFP/NEON Q 128 bit register write.)
    Field ID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The register number.)
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:16 (The new value written to the register.)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:16 (The old value overwritten.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field ALIASING type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Type of register aliasing used)
        0x1 = AArch32
        0x2 = AArch64
    Field MASK type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:2 (Each bit indicates a write to the corresponding byte in the register. For example, 0x1 would indicate a write to VALUE[7:0])

Source VFP_SYS_REGS (Writes to the VFP/NEON units system registers.)
    Field ID type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Which VFP system register is written.)
        0x1 = FPSCR
        0x8 = FPEXC
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The new value written to the VFP system register.)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The register's old value overwritten.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field MASK type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The mask indicating updated cumulative bits.)

Source VFP_S_REGS (VFP/NEON S 32 bit register write.)
    Field ID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The register number.)
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The new value written to the register.)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The old value overwritten.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field ALIASING type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Type of register aliasing used.)
        0x1 = AArch32
        0x2 = AArch64
    Field MASK type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Each bit indicates a write to the corresponding bit in the register. For example, 0x1 would indicate a write to VALUE[0])

Source WAYPOINT (Signals end of basic block execution.)
    Field PC type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Origin address (or 0 if unavailable))
    Field ISET type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Origin instruction set)
        0x0 = ARM
        0x1 = Thumb
        0x2 = Jazelle
        0x4 = AArch64
    Field TARGET type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Destination address)
    Field TARGET_ISET type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Destination instruction set)
        0x0 = ARM
        0x1 = Thumb
        0x2 = Jazelle
        0x4 = AArch64
    Field TAKEN type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Indicates if this waypoint was taken.)
    Field IS_COND type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Indicates if this is a conditional waypoint.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)

Source WFE_END (WFE ended.)
    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Ticks count when leaving WFE.)

Source WFE_EVENT_REGISTER (WFE event register status: set/clear, reason.)
    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Ticks count.)
    Field REASON type:MTI_ENUM size:4 (Reason for set/clear. Only REASON==0 (Cleared by WFE) clears the bit, all other reasons set it.)
        0x0 = Cleared by WFE
        0x1 = Set by SEV instruction (this or another core)
        0x2 = Set by Exception Return
        0x3 = Set by external FIQ

        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = Periodic Sync
        0x2 = PreBusAccess
        0x3 = SyncBarrier
        0x4 = Data Synchronization Barrier
        0x5 = Data Memory Barrier
        0x6 = Error Synchronization Barrier
        0x7 = Instruction Synchronization Barrier
        0x8 = Core scheduler set value and sync
        0x9 = Core scheduler delay
        0xa = Core scheduler sleep
        0xb = Wait For Interrupt
        0xc = Wait For Event
        0xd = Core sending event
        0xe = Set or clear signal
        0xf = Timer Synchronization
        0x10 = ARM debug

    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Ticks count at point of transition.)
    Field NEW type:MTI_ENUM size:4 (New run state.)
        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = RUNNING
        0x2 = HALTED
        0x3 = STANDBY_WFE
        0x4 = STANDBY_WFI
        0x5 = IN_RESET
        0x6 = DORMANT
        0x7 = SHUTDOWN
        0x8 = BARRIER_WAIT
    Field OLD type:MTI_ENUM size:4 (Old run state.)
        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = RUNNING
        0x2 = HALTED
        0x3 = STANDBY_WFE
        0x4 = STANDBY_WFI
        0x5 = IN_RESET
        0x6 = DORMANT
        0x7 = SHUTDOWN
        0x8 = BARRIER_WAIT

Source SEMIHOSTING_CALL (Call of a semihost function occurred.)
    Field PC type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The program counter after the semihosting call.)

Source SEMIHOSTING_PRECALL (About to call semihost.)
    Field REG_WIDTH type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The current register width in bytes.)
    Field NS type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is Non-Secure.)
    Field EL2 type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Use EL2 translation regime.)

Source SIGNAL (External signal state change.)
    Field SIGNAL type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Signal that changed)
        0x0 = FIQ
        0x1 = IRQ
        0x2 = VFIQ
        0x3 = VIRQ
        0x4 = SignalNMIFiq
        0x5 = SignalNMIIrq
        0x6 = SignalNMIVFiq
        0x7 = SignalNMIVIrq
        0x8 = Reset
        0x9 = SystemError
        0xa = VirtualSystemError
        0xb = Abort
        0xc = Debug
        0xd = Halt
        0xe = OSUnlockCatch
        0xf = POReset
        0x10 = SysPOReset
        0x11 = DebugReset
        0x12 = ResetHold
        0x14 = CP15SDisable
        0x15 = CP15SDisable2
    Field STATE type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Signal asserted state)

Source SOFTWARE_STEP (Return the Debug Software Step state.)
    Field STATE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Software Step state)
        0x0 = Inactive
        0x1 = Active
        0x2 = Active-Pending

Source SPSR (SPSR change.)
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The new SPSR value)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The old SPSR value)
    Field MODE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Which of the banked SPSR registers is written.)
        0x0 = EL0t
        0x4 = EL1t
        0x5 = EL1h
        0x8 = EL2t
        0x9 = EL2h
        0xc = EL3t
        0xd = EL3h
        0x11 = fiq
        0x12 = irq
        0x13 = svc
        0x16 = mon
        0x17 = abt
        0x1a = hyp
        0x1b = und
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)

Source SUBOPTIMAL_LDST_RETIRED (suboptimal load/store.)
    Field VADDR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The virtual address of the access)
    Field ACCESS_SIZE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Log2 of the access width in bytes used for alignment checking (1: half-word, 2: word ...))
    Field OPTIMAL_ALIGN_SELECTOR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Selector to decide the optimal alignment size (1: access width, 2: 4-bytes, 3: 8-bytes, ..., 12: 4-kbytes))

Source SYNC (Called for every synchronization, that is every quantum break.)
    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The instruction count of this CPU.)
    Field LOCAL_TIME type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The local time of this CPU.)
    Field LOCAL_QUANTUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The local quantum of this CPU.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field SYNC_REASON type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Reason for sync.)
        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = Periodic Sync
        0x2 = PreBusAccess
        0x3 = SyncBarrier
        0x4 = Data Synchronization Barrier
        0x5 = Data Memory Barrier
        0x6 = Error Synchronization Barrier
        0x7 = Instruction Synchronization Barrier
        0x8 = Core scheduler set value and sync
        0x9 = Core scheduler delay
        0xa = Core scheduler sleep
        0xb = Wait For Interrupt
        0xc = Wait For Event
        0xd = Core sending event
        0xe = Set or clear signal
        0xf = Timer Synchronization
        0x10 = ARM debug

    Field TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (System call type.)
        0x0 = SVC
        0x1 = HVC
        0x2 = SMC
    Field IMM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Immediate value of the system call instruction.)

Source VFP_D_REGS (VFP/NEON D 64 bit register write.)
    Field ID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The register number.)
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The new value written to the register.)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The old value overwritten.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field ALIASING type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Type of register aliasing used)
        0x1 = AArch32
        0x2 = AArch64
    Field MASK type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Each bit indicates a write to the corresponding bit in the register. For example, 0x1 would indicate a write to VALUE[0])

    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:16 (The new value written to the register.)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:16 (The old value overwritten.)

        0x2 = Jazelle

        0x0 = S
        0x1 = NS
        0x2 = RT
        0x3 = RL
        0xff = Invalid
    Field NS type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The core's non-secure bit.)
    Field SECURITY_STATE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The core's security state.)
        0x0 = S
        0x1 = NS
        0x2 = RT
        0x3 = RL
    Field ITSTATE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The current ITSTATE.)
    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The core's instruction counter, starting at 1 for the first instruction.)
    Field LOCAL_TIME type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The core's local time, relative to the current quantum.)
    Field CURRENT_TIME type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The core's current time, as simulated time plus local time.)

    Field DISASS type:MTI_STRING size:0 max_size:256 (Disassembly of instruction.)

Source MMU_TRANS (Address translation information.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field SIDE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Inst / Data.)
        0x0 = Inst
        0x1 = Data

        0x1 = NonSecure

        0x2 = Device-nGRE
        0x3 = Device-GRE
        0x4 = Normal
    Field OUTERCACHE_TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Outer Caching scheme (NC/MB/WA).)
        0x0 = NonCacheable
        0x1 = WriteThrough
        0x2 = WriteBack
    Field OUTERCACHE_RA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the outer cache allocate on read)
    Field OUTERCACHE_WA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the outer cache allocate on write)
    Field OUTERCACHE_TRANSIENT type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the outer write-through transient)
    Field INNERCACHE_TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Inner Caching scheme (NC/MB/WA).)
        0x0 = NonCacheable
        0x1 = WriteThrough
        0x2 = WriteBack
    Field INNERCACHE_RA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the inner cache allocate on read)
    Field INNERCACHE_WA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the inner cache allocate on write)
    Field INNERCACHE_TRANSIENT type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the inner write-through transient)
    Field SH type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Shareability)
        0x0 = NonShareable
        0x1 = InnerShareable
        0x2 = OuterShareable
    Field STAGE1_PERM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Stage 1 permissions, [5:3] Privileged access (XWR) [2:0] User access (XWR))
    Field STAGE2_PERM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Stage 2 permission mask [5:3] Privileged access (XWR) [2:0] User access (XWR))
    Field XS type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (XS Attribute)
    Field PAS type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (PAS supposed to be accessed is secure or nonsecure memory or Root/Realm if RME is implemented)
        0x0 = S
        0x1 = NS
        0x2 = RT
        0x3 = RL
        0xff = Invalid
    Field MECID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:2 (Memory Encryption Context(MEC) ID, if applicable.)

    Field COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Number of blocks of data to access)
    Field REUSE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Maximum number of bytes to be accessed before next RPRFM )
    Field OP type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Range prefetch operation )

Source RUN_STATE (Run state transition.)
    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Ticks count at point of transition.)
    Field NEW type:MTI_ENUM size:4 (New run state.)
        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = RUNNING
        0x2 = HALTED
        0x3 = STANDBY_WFE
        0x4 = STANDBY_WFI
        0x5 = IN_RESET
        0x6 = DORMANT
        0x7 = SHUTDOWN
        0x8 = BARRIER_WAIT
    Field OLD type:MTI_ENUM size:4 (Old run state.)
        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = RUNNING
        0x2 = HALTED
        0x3 = STANDBY_WFE
        0x4 = STANDBY_WFI
        0x5 = IN_RESET
        0x6 = DORMANT
        0x7 = SHUTDOWN
        0x8 = BARRIER_WAIT

Source SEMIHOSTING_CALL (Call of a semihost function occurred.)
    Field PC type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The program counter after the semihosting call.)

Source SEMIHOSTING_PRECALL (About to call semihost.)
    Field REG_WIDTH type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (The current register width in bytes.)
    Field NS type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is Non-Secure.)
    Field EL2 type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Use EL2 translation regime.)

Source SIGNAL (External signal state change.)
    Field SIGNAL type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Signal that changed)
        0x0 = FIQ
        0x1 = IRQ
        0x2 = VFIQ
        0x3 = VIRQ
        0x4 = SignalNMIFiq
        0x5 = SignalNMIIrq
        0x6 = SignalNMIVFiq
        0x7 = SignalNMIVIrq
        0x8 = Reset
        0x9 = SystemError
        0xa = VirtualSystemError
        0xb = Abort
        0xc = Debug
        0xd = Halt
        0xe = OSUnlockCatch
        0xf = POReset
        0x10 = SysPOReset
        0x11 = DebugReset
        0x12 = ResetHold
        0x14 = CP15SDisable
        0x15 = CP15SDisable2
    Field STATE type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Signal asserted state)

Source SOFTWARE_STEP (Return the Debug Software Step state.)
    Field STATE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Software Step state)
        0x0 = Inactive
        0x1 = Active
        0x2 = Active-Pending

Source SPSR (SPSR change.)
    Field VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The new SPSR value)
    Field OLD_VALUE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (The old SPSR value)
    Field MODE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Which of the banked SPSR registers is written.)
        0x0 = EL0t
        0x4 = EL1t
        0x5 = EL1h
        0x8 = EL2t
        0x9 = EL2h
        0xc = EL3t
        0xd = EL3h
        0x11 = fiq
        0x12 = irq
        0x13 = svc
        0x16 = mon
        0x17 = abt
        0x1a = hyp
        0x1b = und
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)

Source START_COMPILE (Compilation started.)

    Field ADDR_END type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Final address.)

Source SUBOPTIMAL_LDST_RETIRED (suboptimal load/store.)
    Field VADDR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The virtual address of the access)
    Field ACCESS_SIZE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Log2 of the access width in bytes used for alignment checking (1: half-word, 2: word ...))
    Field OPTIMAL_ALIGN_SELECTOR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Selector to decide the optimal alignment size (1: access width, 2: 4-bytes, 3: 8-bytes, ..., 12: 4-kbytes))

Source SYNC (Called for every synchronization, that is every quantum break.)
    Field INST_COUNT type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The instruction count of this CPU.)
    Field LOCAL_TIME type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The local time of this CPU.)
    Field LOCAL_QUANTUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (The local quantum of this CPU.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field SYNC_REASON type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Reason for sync.)
        0x0 = UNKNOWN
        0x1 = Periodic Sync
        0x2 = PreBusAccess
        0x3 = SyncBarrier
        0x4 = Data Synchronization Barrier
        0x5 = Data Memory Barrier
        0x6 = Error Synchronization Barrier
        0x7 = Instruction Synchronization Barrier
        0x8 = Core scheduler set value and sync
        0x9 = Core scheduler delay
        0xa = Core scheduler sleep
        0xb = Wait For Interrupt
        0xc = Wait For Event
        0xd = Core sending event
        0xe = Set or clear signal
        0xf = Timer Synchronization
        0x10 = ARM debug

    Field TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (System call type.)
        0x0 = SVC
        0x1 = HVC
        0x2 = SMC
    Field IMM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Immediate value of the system call instruction.)

Source MMU_TRANS (Address translation information.)
    Field CORE_NUM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Core number in a multi processor.)
    Field SIDE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Inst / Data.)
        0x0 = Inst
        0x1 = Data
    Field ASID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:2 (Address space identifier.)
    Field VMID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Virtual machine identifier.)
    Field VADDR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Virtual address of the access.)
    Field Hyp type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Entry matches in Hyp state only)
    Field nG type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Flag indicating whether ASID will be matched)
        0x0 = Global
        0x1 = Non-Global
    Field NSDESC type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Is secure side supposed to access secure or nonsecure memory)
        0x0 = Secure
        0x1 = NonSecure
    Field PADDR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Physical address of the access.)
    Field PAGESIZE type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Page size as log2(size).)
    Field MEMTYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Memory type.)
        0x0 = Device-nGnRnE (StronglyOrdered)
        0x1 = Device-nGnRE (Device)
        0x2 = Device-nGRE
        0x3 = Device-GRE
        0x4 = Normal
    Field OUTERCACHE_TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Outer Caching scheme (NC/MB/WA).)
        0x0 = NonCacheable
        0x1 = WriteThrough
        0x2 = WriteBack
    Field OUTERCACHE_RA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the outer cache allocate on read)
    Field OUTERCACHE_WA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the outer cache allocate on write)
    Field OUTERCACHE_TRANSIENT type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the outer write-through transient)
    Field INNERCACHE_TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Inner Caching scheme (NC/MB/WA).)
        0x0 = NonCacheable
        0x1 = WriteThrough
        0x2 = WriteBack
    Field INNERCACHE_RA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the inner cache allocate on read)
    Field INNERCACHE_WA type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the inner cache allocate on write)
    Field INNERCACHE_TRANSIENT type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (Is the inner write-through transient)
    Field SH type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (Shareability)
        0x0 = NonShareable
        0x1 = InnerShareable
        0x2 = OuterShareable
    Field STAGE1_PERM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Stage 1 permissions, [5:3] Privileged access (XWR) [2:0] User access (XWR))
    Field STAGE2_PERM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:1 (Stage 2 permission mask [5:3] Privileged access (XWR) [2:0] User access (XWR))
    Field XS type:MTI_BOOL size:1 (XS Attribute)
    Field PAS type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (PAS supposed to be accessed is secure or nonsecure memory or Root/Realm if RME is implemented)
        0x0 = S
        0x1 = NS
        0x2 = RT
        0x3 = RL
        0xff = Invalid
    Field MECID type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:2 (Memory Encryption Context(MEC) ID, if applicable.)

        0x5 = Data Memory Barrier
        0x6 = Error Synchronization Barrier
        0x7 = Instruction Synchronization Barrier
        0x8 = Core scheduler set value and sync
        0x9 = Core scheduler delay
        0xa = Core scheduler sleep
        0xb = Wait For Interrupt
        0xc = Wait For Event
        0xd = Core sending event
        0xe = Set or clear signal
        0xf = Timer Synchronization
        0x10 = ARM debug

Source SYSCALL (System call instruction executed.)
    Field VADDR type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:8 (Instruction that caused the system call.)
    Field TYPE type:MTI_ENUM size:1 (System call type.)
        0x0 = SVC
        0x1 = HVC
        0x2 = SMC
    Field IMM type:MTI_UNSIGNED_INT size:4 (Immediate value of the system call instruction.)
